entities.summary: Sakākā, often spelled Sakakah is a city in northwestern Saudi Arabia which is the capital of Al-Jawf Province. It is located at 650 metres above sea level just to the north of the An Nafud desert. Sakakah had a population of 204,174 at the 2022 census.
